description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Inlet Beach Reunion House,”, a thoughtfully designed luxury retreat built for large family gatherings and milestone celebrations. This 8-bedroom, 8.5-bathroom estate in Inlet Beach offers everything you need for a truly unforgettable vacation. With a private pool and spa, multiple living areas, Gulf views from the third floor, and a game room for all ages—this home was made for connection, comfort, and coastal living. Just a 3-minute walk to the beach and 2 minutes to 30Avenue, you’ll enjoy easy access to Inlet’s best shopping, dining, and natural beauty. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Sprawling 8 Bedroom Home: Accommodates up to 30 guests with 8.5 bathrooms and spacious common areasGulf Views from the 3rd Floor: Enjoy coastal breezes and beautiful sunsetsPrivate Pool + Spa: Heated seasonally, with patio dining, a grassy yard, and gamesGame Room + Dual Laundry Rooms: Family-friendly amenities for extended staysChef’s Kitchen for a Crowd: Double fridges, dishwashers, and seating for 20+3-Minute Walk to the Beach: Quick stroll to sugar-white sand10 Adult Bikes Included: Cruise to 30Avenue, Rosemary Beach, or Camp Helen State Park*** LIVING AREA ***The main living room on the first floor sets the tone for your stay with plush seating, a large flat-screen TV, and direct access to the backyard. Meanwhile, the third-floor game room serves as a bonus hangout with a wet bar, ping pong, and balcony Gulf views.First-floor open living area with comfortable sofa & armchairsFlat-screen TV for relaxing movie nightsDouble doors leading to poolside patioThird-floor family game room with ping pong table, wet bar, 2 TVs & game table*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Perfectly suited for large-group meals, this chef-style kitchen features stainless steel appliances, two refrigerators, two dishwashers, and a gas range. The dining area seats 16+, and there’s bar seating for 4 at the kitchen island.Full kitchen with double refrigerators and dishwashersGas range + ample counter space for group cookingDining table seats 16+ with adjacent bar seating for 4Fully stocked with cookware, dishes & more*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Step outside to a private backyard retreat, perfect for both lively group fun and laid-back lounging. Whether you're starting your day with coffee by the pool or firing up the gas grill for an evening cookout, this outdoor space was designed with unforgettable gatherings in mind.Private pool & spa (heated Sept. 1 – April 30)Grassy yard with cornhole boards—perfect for family gamesPatio dining for 12 with plenty of space for group mealsBuilt-in gas grill for easy outdoor cookingLounge seating and secure fencing for safety and relaxation*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, en-suite with single vanity & shower/tub comboHalf Bathroom: Convenient for shared living space2nd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, Twin over Twin Bunk, balcony access, en-suite with walk-in showerKing Guest Suite: King bed, desk space, balcony access, en-suite with dual vanities & walk-in showerKing Guest Suite: King bed, balcony access, en-suite with single vanity & shower/tub comboKing Guest Suite: King bed, Twin over Twin Bunk, balcony access, en-suite with single vanity & walk-in showerFull Laundry Room with washer & dryer3rd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, balcony access, flat-screen TV, en-suite with shower/tub comboBunk Room: Twin over Twin + Full over Full BunkBunk Room: 2 Queen over Queen Bunks, en-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerGuest Bathroom: Single vanity with shower/tub comboStacked Washer & Dryer in hallway*** GAME ROOM & FAMILY FUN ***Let the good times roll on the third floor, where the vibrant game room invites both laughter and laid-back lounging. Whether you're hosting a family ping pong tournament, enjoying cocktails at the wet bar, or catching a movie after sunset, this space is a favorite for guests of all ages.Ping pong table for friendly family competitionsGame table with seating for 4 — perfect for board games or card nightsWet bar with mini fridge to keep drinks and snacks close at handDual flat-screen TVs for sports, movies, or simultaneous entertainmentGulf-view balcony access — the ideal backdrop for a sunset showdown*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Perfectly located in the quiet Inlet Beach community, this home is just minutes from the action—but tucked away enough for peace and privacy.3-minute walk to beach access2-minute drive to 30Avenue for boutique shopping, restaurants, coffee shops & live music3-minute drive to Camp Helen State Park — kayak, hike, or fish in natural beautyClose to Rosemary & Alys Beach — just a short bike ride*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe do NOT accept wire transfers for paymentPool heated seasonally (Sept. 1 - April 30)Waiver required to get access to the 10 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and connection.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***
